text: What is new: I B M Granite Time Series models now run inside Confluent. Every event in your stream is scored in flight, with no training.
One line of Flink S Q L forecasts the next thirty-two steps, with the band.
Forecast it, then optimize it. The optimizer picks the setting that earns the most and still meets spec.
Then an agent acts. Forecast, flag, reasoning, purchase order, in under a second.
The value: ten times faster to value, five to ten percent more accurate, and decisions in seconds, not days.
The use cases: mission-critical decisions. Production, anomalies, supply chain, fraud, search and trading.
Take fraud. Every card has its own normal, so the odd swipe is held before authorization.
In the field, I B M Network Intelligence opens a ticket only when the cause is confirmed.
In cement, thirty models become two, and accuracy rises from ninety-three to ninety-nine percent.
